content.introduction: A comprehensive guide to the final damage calculation formula in Wuthering Waves.

main_formula.title: Final Damage Formula
main_formula.formula: Final Damage = Skill Multiplier × Base ATK × Multiplier Sum
main_formula.others_formula: Multiplier Sum = ATK × DMG Bonus × Crit × Boost × RES × DEF × DMG Taken × Total DMG

sections.title: Multiplier
sections.description: The product of the skill's intrinsic multipliers:
sections.formula: Multiplier = Skill Rate × DMG Rate × DMG Rate 2
sections.note: DMG Rate and DMG Rate 2 are usually 1; some Resonators apply DMG-rate increases multiplicatively (DMG Rate 2).

sections.title: Base ATK
sections.description: The sum of the raw stats from the Resonator and their Weapon:
sections.note: Note: For skills scaling with DEF or HP (e.g., Taoqi), use the corresponding Base Stat instead.

sections.title: ATK
sections.description: All bonus values applied to the Base ATK:
details: Flat ATK converted into a percentage relative to Base ATK

sections.title: DMG bonus
sections.description: Sum of damage type and attribute bonuses:

sections.title: Crit
sections.description: Expected damage multiplier based on Critical hits:
sections.note: The default Crit DMG in Wuthering Waves is 150% (1.5).

sections.title: Boost (DMG Deepen)
sections.description: Independent multipliers primarily provided by Outro Skills:
amplification_types: Attribute-specific DMG Boost (e.g., Electro DMG Boost)

sections.title: RES Multiplier
sections.description: Damage variance based on the target's Attribute Resistance:
sections.simulator_note: Simulator implementation: RES = 0.8 + Penetration. Enemy resistance is fixed at 20%, and excess over-penetration (negative RES) is reflected at half value. The high-resistance branch 1/(1+5×RES) from the original game does not occur in the simulator.

sections.title: DEF Multiplier
sections.description: Defense calculation considering Level difference and DEF Ignore:
sections.formula: DEF Multiplier = (800 + 8 × Lvl_Char) / (800 + 8 × Lvl_Char + (792 + 8 × Lvl_Enemy) × (1 - DEF_Ignore) × (1 - DEF_Reduction))
conditions: DEF Ignore: Penetration or Ignore ratio (e.g., 0.3)
DEF Reduction: Enemy DEF reduction ratio (e.g., 0.2)
